title: The Battle of Midway 1942: Told from the Japanese Perspective (1/3)
summary: Part one of Montemayor's animated-map documentary on the Battle of Midway, told using only the information available to the Japanese side. It focuses on Nagumo's dilemma.
why: HN recommends it for its information-dense maps and voice-over and for showing how commanders decide with limited information.

quote.text: This youtube series telling the Battle of Midway from Japanese perspective
